source: reconstruction of a GitLab project testing on node:latest with a pinned release
note: The spec's own clean example (section 7, group b): the tests run on node:latest, a mutable image, in a job no secret is scoped to (NPM_TOKEN is scoped to the npm environment, which only the release job uses); the release runs on tags with a digest-pinned image. Settings of a third-party project cannot be read, so the facts are reproduced. A mutable image into a job holding nothing is code execution alone on an ephemeral runner: Low, and the only path is that one image (the forbidden tag and the missing digest are two findings on one subject, so they anchor one path together). Hand count: one Low path 3, no other finding, so 100 - 3 = 97: A.
